rows.text: §｟Book｠ I¶▼Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked,/_nor stand on the path of sinners,/_nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
/but his delight is in Yahweh’s law./_On his law he meditates day and night.
/He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water,/_that produces its fruit in its season,/_whose leaf also does not wither./_Whatever he does shall prosper.
